Preferences

Settings

My Account

Your Instagram account in the in-app browser. Sign in directly with Instagram; the WebView2 browser profile persists on this PC across app restarts.

▾
No account linkedYou are not signed in

Instagram handles sign-in directly. The app does not collect your password, and your browser sign-in also unlocks restricted posts in saved-post resolution. Log Out clears the Instagram session kept in the app's browser profile on this PC.

Import posts from JSON

Choose a JSON file from your PC to extract post links from its label_values entries and display them in the Library.

▾

Looks through each element's label_values for a label named URL, copies its value, and creates a Library cell for every post.

Theme

Switch between the Default theme and 15 custom UI themes across the entire app.

▾

Background

Choose a photo or animated GIF. Crop photos, and use the shared opacity control for either.

▾

The original dark gradient stays underneath the image.

Loading screen

Every start plays one of five loading screens. Turn them on or off — the soundtrack lives under the Sound tab.

▾
Loading screens

When off, the app opens straight away — no loading screen and no soundtrack.

LET ME OUT!

Choose how the app should close.

▾
App exit

Off: catch the imp to open the exit prompt. On: click the top-right exit icon to open the same prompt.

Loading screen soundtrack

Each of the five loading screens has its own score. Turn it on or off and set how loud it plays.

▾
Sound

100% is the level the soundtracks were mixed at. Drop it if the loading screen is too loud, or to 0% to mute it while leaving the sound switched on.

UI sounds

Choose the button-click sound, turn it off, or adjust its loudness.

▾
Button clicks

Choosing a sound previews it, using the current click-sound switch and volume.

100% is the level the click was designed at. Drop it to 0% to silence button clicks while leaving them switched on.

Saving folder

Choose where downloaded photos and videos will be saved.

▾

When enabled, videos use the folder above; otherwise, videos and photos use the Download location.

Skip already-downloaded photos and videos. When off, existing names get numbered suffixes instead.

Resized photos folder

Choose where resized images are saved and control duplicate handling for resized outputs.

▾

Skip existing resized-photo filenames. When off, numbered suffixes are used. This setting is independent of downloaded-media duplicates.

How to export

Profile -> Settings -> Account Center -> Your information and permissions -> Export your information, then click Create export -> Customize it and then click on Start Export -> Wait
